description: Scan sliding consecutive night windows for a target Disney resort (e.g. find 4 consecutive nights at Disney's Riviera Resort between Oct 10 and Oct 18, checking all 5 candidate sliding windows: 10-14, 11-15, 12-16, 13-17, 14-18). Returns exact room type, package name, nightly rate, total stay price, tax, and direct booking links.

endDate.description: Latest departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-10-18").

nights.description: Number of consecutive nights needed (e.g. 4 or 5).

resort.description: Target Disney resort name, slug, or ID (e.g. "riviera", "grand floridian", "18995875").

startDate.description: Earliest arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-10-10").

name: scan_resort_room_windows
